title: Restriction of scalars identifies strict Koszul towers and their units
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site, $\varphi:R\to B$ a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings, and $a_1,\ldots,a_r$ a finite list of global sections of $R$, allowing $r=0$. Assume $B$ is flat over $R$, meaning that $B\otimes_R-$ is exact. Use module sheaves and unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and restriction of scalars $\operatorname{Res}$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. For $O=R,B$, write $a_{j,R}=a_j$ and $a_{j,B}=\varphi(a_j)$, and define
$$Q_m(O)=\bigotimes_{j=1}^r[O\xrightarrow{a_{j,O}^m}O]\qquad(m\geq1)$$
in degrees $[-r,0]$, using the total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Give these the inverse transition $(a_{j,O},1)$ in each two-term factor and the degree-zero maps $O[0]\to Q_m(O)$, as in [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. For any unbounded $B$-module complex $C$, put $T_B(C)_m=\operatorname{Tot}(C\otimes_BQ_m(B))$ and $T_R(\operatorname{Res}C)_m=\operatorname{Tot}(\operatorname{Res}C\otimes_RQ_m(R))$.

There is a canonical natural isomorphism of strict towers of complexes
$$\operatorname{Res}T_B(C)\xrightarrow{\sim}T_R(\operatorname{Res}C).$$
On the summand indexed by any exterior basis element it is the identity on $\operatorname{Res}C$. It commutes with the transition maps and the degree-zero maps from $\operatorname{Res}C$. With $R\lim$ the total right derived inverse limit of strict towers [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], this induces a natural isomorphism
$$\gamma_C:\operatorname{Res}(R\lim_m T_B(C)_m)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\lim_mT_R(\operatorname{Res}C)_m.$$
Writing $\eta_B$ and $\eta_R$ for the units induced by those degree-zero maps, one has $\gamma_C\circ\operatorname{Res}(\eta_B)=\eta_R$. The isomorphism also identifies every derived-limit evaluation with the corresponding restricted evaluation. These comparisons descend to $D(B)$ independently of the representative $C$. For $r=0$ they give the identity under the constant-tower identifications.

source.place: Tag 0A0E (lemma-derived-completion-koszul), finite free Koszul model; derived-limit restriction is Tag 0A07 (sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-Rf-commutes-with-Rlim), specialized to the identity topos with flat structural ring map. The strict tower, evaluation and unit normalization are made explicit.
